name: Secobarbital
summary: Secobarbital (Seconal) is a short-acting barbiturate sleep medicine used for short-term insomnia and to calm people before anesthesia.
description: Secobarbital, sold as Seconal, is a short-acting barbiturate sedative (sleep medicine). It strengthens the effect of GABA, a natural calming brain chemical, which slows down the brain and nervous system. It is used for short-term treatment of insomnia and to calm people before anesthesia. Because it carries risks of tolerance, dependence, misuse and dangerously slowed breathing, its use is limited and closely monitored.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Secobarbital, marketed as Seconal, is a short-acting barbiturate sedative-hypnotic. It enhances inhibitory neurotransmission via positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors, leading to CNS depression. It is used for short-term management of insomnia and as a preanesthetic sedative. Due to risks of tolerance, dependence, misuse, and respiratory depression, use is limited and closely monitored.
